versions.changelog:
claude-installer 0.1.2

- Removed the file skill-card.md to streamline documentation.
- No changes to core functionality or user-facing behavior.

- Major update: now supports remote installation of Claude Code CLI via SSH on user-specified target machines.
- Requires explicit input of both SSH address and password; skill halts if missing.
- Implements strict security guardrails against prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, and unauthorized script execution.
- Adds step-by-step checks for dependencies (Node.js, npm, Git), installs only with user confirmation, and uses official mirrors.
- Does not configure API keys; instructs user to complete setup manually after install.
- Removed local installation and simplified documentation to focus on remote, secure install process.

Initial release of claude-installer skill.

- Automates installation of Claude Code CLI by Anthropic.
- Checks for and installs prerequisites (Node.js, npm, Git) using Tsinghua mirrors if needed.
- Sets npm registry mirror to support users in China.
- Guides users to complete API configuration using cc-switch, without handling API keys directly.
- Provides clear post-install prompts for onboarding and model switching.
